# Reeds: a clump of nine tapered blades (0.8 to 1.55 m, leaning a little) and three cattails (a
# brown head on a stalk). Origin on the ground at the clump's centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Reed --base-color 0.1804 0.2510 0.2392 --no-slot
material new Cattail --base-color 0.6196 0.4941 0.4549 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Bl0 --size 1 --location -0.170 -0.166 0.698
scale 0.09 0.06 1.396
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.628"
scale 0.35 0.6 1
mode object
set rotation 8.0 4.3 166
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Bl1 --size 1 --location 0.147 0.027 0.754
scale 0.09 0.06 1.508
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.678"
scale 0.35 0.6 1
mode object
set rotation 2.7 7.2 20
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Bl2 --size 1 --location -0.077 0.015 0.604
scale 0.09 0.06 1.208
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.544"
scale 0.35 0.6 1
mode object
set rotation 1.3 -8.8 39
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Bl3 --size 1 --location -0.054 0.288 0.687
scale 0.09 0.06 1.374
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.618"
scale 0.35 0.6 1
mode object
set rotation -6.1 5.3 25
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Bl4 --size 1 --location -0.030 -0.027 0.401
scale 0.09 0.06 0.801
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.361"
scale 0.35 0.6 1
mode object
set rotation 6.7 -5.2 39
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Bl5 --size 1 --location 0.277 -0.031 0.508
scale 0.09 0.06 1.017
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.458"
scale 0.35 0.6 1
mode object
set rotation 8.3 0.7 122
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Bl6 --size 1 --location 0.084 0.289 0.659
scale 0.09 0.06 1.318
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.593"
scale 0.35 0.6 1
mode object
set rotation 8.4 7.1 54
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Bl7 --size 1 --location -0.034 0.041 0.455
scale 0.09 0.06 0.909
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.409"
scale 0.35 0.6 1
mode object
set rotation -7.8 -3.6 109
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Bl8 --size 1 --location 0.217 0.005 0.527
scale 0.09 0.06 1.053
apply --scale
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.474"

set rotation -3.4 5.7 87

add mesh cylinder --name St0 --vertices 5 --radius 0.035 --depth 1.15 --location 0.166 0.070 0.575
add mesh cylinder --name Hd0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.075 --depth 0.3 --location 0.166 0.070 1.100
add mesh cylinder --name St1 --vertices 5 --radius 0.035 --depth 1.35 --location -0.144 0.109 0.675
add mesh cylinder --name Hd1 --vertices 6 --radius 0.075 --depth 0.3 --location -0.144 0.109 1.300
add mesh cylinder --name St2 --vertices 5 --radius 0.035 --depth 1.55 --location -0.022 -0.179 0.775
add mesh cylinder --name Hd2 --vertices 6 --radius 0.075 --depth 0.3 --location -0.022 -0.179 1.500
select Bl0 Bl1 Bl2 Bl3 Bl4 Bl5 Bl6 Bl7 Bl8 St0 St1 St2
active Bl0
join
rename Bl0 Reeds
material assign Reed
select Hd0 Hd1 Hd2
active Hd0
join
rename Hd0 Heads
material assign Cattail
select all
shade flat
export reeds.glb
